name: Diophantus
contribution: A Greek mathematician who was the author of the Arithmetica in thirteen books, ten of which are still extant, made up of arithmetical problems that are solved through algebraic equations.

checks.lead: Diophantus of Alexandria (; Ancient Greek: Διόφαντος, romanized: Diophantos; fl. 250 CE) was a Greek mathematician who was the author of the Arithmetica in thirteen books, ten of which are still extant, made up of arithmetical problems that are solved through algebraic equations.
